resources.string: Shown while the phone is discoverable by your Mac.
Asks you to approve each unlock request.
Tap Approve to unlock this Mac.
Broadcast signal and authenticate requests from your paired Mac.
Stop broadcasting without forgetting the pairing.
Hold each unlock request until you tap Approve. Blocks unattended unlocks.
Broadcasts more frequently to detect your phone faster. Uses slightly more battery.
Use this if your Mac stops unlocking even though everything looks fine. Disconnects the Mac and restarts advertising so both sides start over.
Reset done — disconnected and restarted broadcasting.
You denied the last unlock. Your Mac won\'t ask again for %1$d:%2$02d — this is deliberate, not a fault.
UnlockMyMac needs Nearby devices permission to broadcast as a Bluetooth peripheral. It never scans for other devices and never uses your location.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to become discoverable.
Battery optimisation is on for this app. Android may stop the service after a while, and your Mac will quietly stop unlocking. Allow unrestricted background use to keep it running.
On Samsung, also remove this app from Settings › Battery › Background usage limits › Sleeping apps.
This Mac is requesting permission to unlock.
Start pairing on the Mac menu-bar app, then scan the QR code it shows.
Camera access is needed to scan the pairing QR code.
Waiting for %1$s to connect… %2$d s left
Keep this screen open. The Mac will read this phone\'s public key over Bluetooth.
Compare this fingerprint with the one shown on the Mac before you trust it.
Pairing window closed. Scan the QR code again.
That QR code is not a UnlockMyMac pairing code.
That pairing code has expired. Generate a new one on the Mac.
This phone is already paired with %1$s. Pairing again replaces it.
Turn on \"Discoverable by Mac\" first — pairing happens over Bluetooth and needs the peripheral running.
Forget %1$s? A new identity key is generated, so you will need to pair again.
Challenges and signatures are never logged; entries show a short digest instead.
